hook: YOUR *MOTHER IS ILL AND YOU ARE *FAR AWAY
title: F36 · far_away · Her Mother Is Unwell
lines: n
I am fine, beta. Do not come. You have the children.
"I am fine, beta. Do not come. You have the children."
n
Her mother has fever. She is seventy-eight. And six hundred kilometres away.
n
Tickets are not there till Friday.
n
She is a mother here and a daughter there, and she cannot be both tonight.
n
Pari tugged her sari. Whisper it to Nandi. He carries it.
Pari tugged her sari. "Whisper it to Nandi. He carries it."
n
She felt foolish. She bent down anyway, and whispered her mother's name.
n
Then she did the things she could do. Called the neighbour there. Paid the doctor online. Booked Friday.
n
At dawn: Fever is down. Who sent the doctor?
At dawn: "Fever is down. Who sent the doctor?"
n
Send what you can. Then send your love. It arrives. That is sadhana.
n
Kailasa. On Google Play.
